newsitem.title: USA: Mothers Work says won't meet Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Mothers Work says won't meet Q4 estimates.

text.p: Mothers Work Inc said it does not expect to meet analysts' estimates in the fourth quarter.

"Although we were very pleased with our comparable store sales gain for the month of August, we nonetheless do not expect to achieve analysts' estimates for the September quarter," said president Rebecca Matthias.
She said that September is typically the largest revenue month of the fourth quarter and critical to whether the company will be profitable for the quarter.

"The newly acquired Episode chain is selling off the excess spring/summer inventory which came with the stores, and although the trend in comparable store performance at Episode is positive, sales results for this quarter so far have been below our plan," she added.
Shares in Mothers Work was down four at 16 in early trade.
